title: 土力工程處指連場暴雨山坡穩定性或受影響　提醒市民保持警覺
news_content:
土力工程處表示，截至早上9時，緊急控制中心共接獲兩宗山泥傾瀉報告，昨日傍晚6時後沒有新增報告。至於早前受山泥傾瀉影響需要臨時封閉的大潭道，已經在完成緊急復修工程後重開。

土力工程處在社交專頁說，接連兩星期的多場暴雨，令山坡穩定性容易受地下水位轉變影響，如果市民身處斜坡附近，應繼續保持警覺，避免短時間內前往曾受大雨影響的山區，如發現所處地點附近發生山泥傾瀉，應立即離開，並在安全情況下報警。

另外，民眾安全服務隊在社交專頁說，民安隊已完成一連串緊急應變及支援工作，暴雨期間指揮中心迅速啟動，水災拯救隊分別前往元朗、粉嶺、上水和北區等地協助巡查，疏導及支援受影響社區。民安隊在暴雨後會持續跟進受影響地區情況，協助社區盡快回復正常生活。



編輯：黃佩珊

title: 美軍在東太平洋打擊一艘販毒船　船上3人死亡
news_content:
美軍南方司令部說，美軍在東太平洋打擊一艘販毒船，船上3人死亡。

美軍在社交平台發表聲明說，美軍「南方之矛」聯合特遣部隊，對一艘由被認定的恐怖組織運營的船隻實施打擊。船上3名男性被打死，美軍無人員傷亡。

自2025年9月初以來，美軍在加勒比海和東太平洋對美方指稱的所謂「販毒船」進行多次打擊，並在當年11月13日宣佈發起「南方之矛」軍事行動。



編輯：方潤南

title: 《環看天下》：BBC裁員550人　節流措施擴大惹關注
news_content:
英國廣播公司BBC日前宣布裁員計劃，首階段削減550人，主要來自新聞部門。公司早前亦已預告，未來幾個月會再削減高層職位，採取不同節流措施，減輕成本壓力。

根據BBC早前公布，公司聘用的全職僱員超過2萬人。當地傳媒報道，幾年內最終裁員人數可能達到2000人，規模屬15年來最大。分析指，隨著串流媒體等興起，BBC近年持續流失付費用戶，尤其是年輕的一群。外界正觀望BBC如何開源，尋求走出經營困境。

title: 孫玉菡強調透過精準扶貧針對目標群組　將協助網織得更密
news_content:
政府公布《香港精準扶貧成果報告》，鎖定三個目標群組，包括劏房、單親及全長者戶，按他們的需要度身訂造精準扶貧項目。勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡在本台節目《千禧年代》表示，今次的報告集中於精準扶貧，針對目標群組，「織更密的網」提供協助。

對於外界關注，當局不再用貧窮線界定貧窮的定義，如果沒有貧窮線，有無其他框架量度貧窮。孫玉菡說，以往的貧窮線是統計概念，純粹基於收入釐定，貧窮線最大的缺點是未能指出誰貧窮、需要甚麼及如何協助。

他表示，本港進入高齡化社會，大部分長者都沒有工作收入，但長者需要的未必是純粹的收入，可能需要其他支援，當局認為純粹以收入講的貧窮，不能夠找出需要幫忙的群組，因此改為精準扶貧。

孫玉菡強調，當局已有許多相關的「兜底計劃」，疊加一起就會更好。他提到新的精準扶貧委員會成立後，會分析如何定點支援有需要人士，又期望年底會有更多有關政商民配對平台的細節，相信政商民聯手提供協助的力度會更大，更好運用資源。



編輯：黃佩珊

title: 世界盃｜加拿大6:0大炒9人應戰的卡塔爾
news_content:
世界盃B組第二輪比賽，東道主之一的加拿大6:0大勝卡塔爾，首次在決賽周取勝。卡塔爾今場先後有兩名球員，被球證以紅牌驅逐離場。

加拿大擁有主場之利，上半場已經領先。16分鐘，拿連近門補中，為加拿大打開紀錄。去到29分鐘，莊拿芬大衛禁區內抽射入網，加拿大領先到2:0。

卡塔爾後衛賀文阿麥，於33分鐘因為推跌單刀的布簡能，被球證以紅牌。加拿大人數佔優，上半場補時階段，莊拿芬大衛近門補射得手。加拿大上半場三球領先。

下半場賽事，卡塔爾球員馬迪保侵犯伊斯馬干尼，球證經VAR覆核後改判紅牌，成為卡塔爾第二名被逐球員。

64分鐘，尼芬沙利巴藉罰球為加拿大射成4:0，入球後尼芬沙利巴於場邊展示伊斯馬干尼的球衣，示意支持隊友。

去到75分鐘，卡塔爾球員艾文賴將球踢入自己球門，加拿大憑對方的烏龍球領先到5:0。莊拿芬大衛在補時階段射入個人今場第三球，加拿大最終大勝6:0。

B組第二輪賽事完成，加拿大成績一勝一和，憑較佳得失球差壓倒同分的瑞士，排名榜首，波斯尼亞第三，卡塔爾暫排榜尾。



編輯：方潤南

title: 伊朗：霍爾木茲海峽未來60日免費通行
news_content:
伊朗伊斯蘭共和國通訊社報道，伊朗最高國家安全委員會發表聲明說，根據伊美諒解備忘錄，在未來60日申請通過霍爾木茲海峽的船隻將免繳相關費用。

聲明說，根據諒解備忘錄，申請通過海峽的商船須向伊朗波斯灣海峽管理局提交申請。在60日期限內，將不向申請通過的船隻收取任何費用。伊方已責成管理局盡快對相關申請予以審查和回覆。

聲明表示，鑑於當前特殊情況以及航道部分區域仍存在安全風險，為確保航行安全並避免海上事故，相關船隻須按照指定航線和規定時間通過霍爾木茲海峽。

聲明還說，有關霍爾木茲海峽通航的具體實施安排和技術細節，將由波斯灣海峽管理局另行公佈。對於包括掃雷在內的其他事項，伊方將依據諒解備忘錄有關規定採取必要措施。


編輯：方潤南

title: 回應宏福苑大火責任　李家超：將按事實證據及錯失嚴重程度追究
news_content:
大埔宏福苑火災發生超過半年，行政長官李家超表示，獨立委員會的工作進度與預期一致，有信心可以按要求在9個月內完成，在委員會提交報告後，政府會認真落實報告建議。在追究責任方面，李家超認為過程及方法一定要公平公正，並非只基於個人喜好或偏見，而是按事實證據、錯失的嚴重程度，以及考慮相稱性以決定懲處。而追究責任的重中之重是追究刑事責任，兩個執法部門已檢控7人及2間公司，共25項控罪。

至於圍標問題，李家超表示，相信獨立委員會的報告會提及相關建議，政府亦同步進行很多研究及分析，其中包括如何加強針對貪污方面的法律、或在其他法律上給予新的權力等，亦會作出系統性的改革，並會積極考慮競委會提出的建議。

編輯：羅詠暉

title: 上任四周年｜李家超：是否連任言之尚早　將聚精會神做好工作
news_content:
中央港澳辦主任、國務院港澳辦主任夏寶龍結束兩日到港考察調研行程時，向行政長官李家超豎起大拇指。李家超接受多間電子傳媒訪問時被問到，是否代表一個祝福、支持他連任時表示，本屆政府餘下任期仍有一年時間，談連任問題言之尚早，將聚精會神做好未來一年工作，推出好的政策令市民受惠。

李家超又說，感謝夏寶龍主任在考察和調研後給予四個肯定，鼓勵特區政府繼續努力，尤其要做好五年規劃的編制工作。他又認為，對他本人或對任何一個公職人員來說，如獲得認同是一種鼓勵，但不會停留在此，而是繼續努力。他相信「沒有最好、只有更好」，會繼續以結果為目標，制定更多政策，令市民受惠。 

本屆政府歷史性完成基本法第23條立法，李家超認為，國安法及維護國家安全條例的訂立，令社會回復秩序，但當社會回復平靜，安全意識必定會下降，所以會提醒市民，國家安全風險可以突如其來，大家要保持警惕，不能「好了傷疤忘了痛」。

對於明年將迎來香港回歸祖國30周年，李家超表示，今次是邁向由治及興新征程上的三十周年紀念，意義重大，已成立由政務司司長負責的特別委員會，部署慶祝和優惠活動，亦會就香港首份五年規劃的重點項目，做好宣傳推廣工作。


編輯：羅詠暉

title: 上任四周年｜李家超：任內經濟向好公屋輪候時間縮短冀市民受惠
news_content:
行政長官李家超接受多間電子傳媒訪問，回顧上任四年來的施政。他表示，經濟向好以及公屋輪候時間縮短，令他感到欣慰。

李家超指出，上任時本港經濟出現大約3.7%負增長，到去年有3.5%的正增長。直至今年首季，經濟增長大約5.9%。而且出入口數字、旅客和消費市道都有上升，經濟前景正面，市民收入亦有增加，對此感到欣喜。另外，公屋綜合輪候時間由他上任時的6.1年，下降至4.7年，即減少了約18個月，他有信心最終能降至4.5年的目標。特區政府亦解決了多個累積多年的問題，包括以簡樸房制度取締劣質劏房、規管網約車等，長遠令市民受惠。

被問到在經濟轉型期間，政府如何協助市民在經濟發展中獲得紅利。李家超表示，經濟活動涉及大環境和自身，大環境由政府負責，正如政府興建了一座運動場，有運動員能跑第一，亦有人三甲不入，因此政府除了強化優勢產業、推動發展創新科技、開拓新興市場，支援中小企及電商等之外，市民和企業都要自強。他說，對經營者有信心，香港一向都不怕風浪，相信在政府不斷做大個餅，加上個人的努力，最終一定會每個領域都能受惠。

李家超又說，香港四年間最大轉變在於在「一國兩制」中由「兩制」抗拒「一國」，變為真正實踐「一國兩制」的內涵。他指出，以往香港花很多時間在爭拗、政治立場問題，現時已回復至「一國兩制」設定的政治環境和制度，特區政府可全神貫注發展經濟、改善民生。更重要是香港要認知機遇在於內地，融入國家並捉緊機遇。他舉例，以往或因政治立場不將內地的科技和技術引入香港，這是固步自封的做法，認為只要符合法律和「一國兩制」，任何對香港好的他都會取用。


編輯：羅詠暉

title: John Lee says HK's talent drive is paying off
news_content:
Chief Executive John Lee has expressed strong confidence in the city’s talent acquisition drive, revealing that more than 290,000 professionals have arrived in the SAR in recent years, easily surpassing the government's target.

In an interview marking his fourth year in office, Lee reflected on the city’s rising international standing, pointing to notable improvements in its global competitiveness rankings as evidence of progress.

"We're doing fairly well, so far so good," he said. "If you look at Hong Kong's competitiveness, it has risen during my term.

"But for talent competitiveness, we've done... I think, a very good result."

The Financial Secretary’s Office announced on Thursday that the city had climbed one spot to become the world’s second-most competitive economy –  its highest ranking since 2019.

The SAR also made a significant leap in talent competitiveness, rising 10 spots to secure fourth place globally.

Lee described the global race for skilled workers as a "competitive game", stressing that "everybody is striving to be more competitive".

"Talent is something that if it is on your side, it will help you. If it's on the opposite side, then it will be very much against you," he said. 

"It's important to get as many talents as possible to be in the Hong Kong team."

The chief executive said the annual target of attracting 35,000 professionals was set during Hong Kong’s post-pandemic recovery period, which he described as cautious.

"At that time when I set the target, I didn't even think of making leaps to make Hong Kong actually become a high-level competitor because after Covid, at the time when all these targets were set, I was thinking of at least making Hong Kong as strong as before," he said. 

"But making Hong Kong as strong as before Covid is not good enough. We have to make it as strong as ever because other people are getting stronger as well."

The 290,000 professionals who have already arrived are estimated to have contributed around 1.2 percent to Hong Kong’s GDP growth, and Lee suggested the real figure could be even higher.

While many of the arrivals are tied to the city’s development as an innovation and technology hub, he noted that traditional sectors such as finance, shipping and trade are also benefiting from the influx.

Lee also said he found that regional leaders and students alike showed strong interest in Hong Kong’s educational offerings during his visits to the Middle East and Central Asia.

"All the country leaders with whom I have met, they've asked for allowing more students from the country to come to Hong Kong," he said.

With five Hong Kong universities ranked among the world’s top 100 and certain programmes achieving global recognition, the city has become an attractive destination for international students, Lee said.

The CE noted that many international students are studying in Hong Kong, many of them willing to pay out of their own pocket.

"That adds to Hong Kong's overall growth in all regards, not just education but other areas such as entertainment and catering because they have to come and they have to spend money.

"And they then remain in Hong Kong to be contributors – as a worker, as a business starter – and they all add to the overall economic gain of Hong Kong."

In a further sign of growing international engagement, Lee revealed that LEAP, a major Middle Eastern technology conference that attracts representatives from more than 180 countries, will host a Hong Kong edition in July.

"We'll continue to strengthen Hong Kong's attraction. That's why Hong Kong is not just a 'super connector', it's a 'super-value adder'," he said. 

Looking ahead, Lee said the administration will maintain its proactive recruitment efforts, emphasising that the competitive global landscape leaves little room for complacency.


Edited by Robert Kemp

title: CE vows to do more to cut public housing wait time
news_content:
Chief Executive John Lee has pledged to intensify efforts to tackle Hong Kong’s housing shortage and further lower the wait for public housing.

He said encouraging progress has been made but that the battle is far from over.

In an interview reviewing the work of his government in the past four years, Lee noted the average waiting time for public housing units has dropped to an eight-year low, to 4.7 years.

He attributed the decline to a combination of policy streamlining, new initiatives and a substantial increase in supply.

"I'm, of course, encouraged by the result, because that is exactly what I want to do when I assumed office – to alleviate the pressing livelihood issues," Lee said, adding that housing was the most critical challenge facing the city at the start of his tenure.

The CE reaffirmed his administration’s goal of cutting the average wait for public housing flats to 4.5 years by next year.

He also pointed out that it takes considerable time to complete traditional public housing projects.

Lee said while his team has amended six ordinances to shorten land-preparation work from 13 years to seven, building a full housing estate still requires another five to six years.

To bridge that gap, he highlighted the Light Public Housing scheme, which aims to deliver 30,000 units by 2027-28 for residents living in cramped or inadequate conditions. 

The chief executive also said the government expanded its five-year public housing supply target by 80 percent compared with four years ago.

Looking ahead, Lee outlined several strategic priorities. These include expanding subsidised home ownership schemes to help residents move from renting to owning and aggressively tackling the misuse of public housing. 

He pointed to the Northern Metropolis as a cornerstone of the city's long-term housing strategy. 

Lee highlighted the Kwu Tung North project as a model for future development, noting it's designed to be a community featuring industries, technology and a university town, with the first phase generating 15,000 units.

"That will be a big help," he said.

"It will be an area newly developed with quite comprehensive provision of facilities, so it's not just a town providing accommodation, it'll be a town providing necessities, facilities, taking care of the occupants' social and occupational needs."

Lee described the Northern Metropolis as a "breakthrough" that will provide better amenities and economic opportunities for its future residents.



Edited by Edmond Fong

title: 'Stay vigilant in safeguarding national security'
news_content:
Chief Executive John Lee said Hong Kong needs to remain vigilant against ongoing national security threats, saying the greatest danger lies in complacency.

In an interview marking his four years in office, he quoted the Chinese saying “Forgetting the pain once the wound has healed”, emphasising that's something people must not do.

Lee said the public must guard against security threats even as life has returned to normal.

"I believe that most people would not do anything to endanger national security. We should work and live normally, but it is important to stay vigilant," he said.

The CE noted that security risks are ever-present and constantly evolving.

"External factors are beyond your control – you can only be in control of your own work in protecting yourself.

The chief executive also said the goal is not to achieve "absolute security".

"We understand that in maintaining national security, we cannot achieve absolute security because absolute security does not exist."

He said the SAR pursues what he described as “relative security”– the goal of being safer today than yesterday.

Lee also described the city's national security system as "defensive" in nature. 

"We do not infringe on others, but when others infringe on us, we need to protect ourselves and hold them accountable," he said.

Lee pointed to the completion of Basic Law Article 23 national security legislation during the current term of government, a constitutional obligation left unfulfilled for more than 26 years since Hong Kong's return to the motherland, along with the implementation of the National Security Law.

"With the enactment of the National Security Law and Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, first of all, Hong Kong's social order has been restored, and our daily lives have returned to normal," he said. 

"Second, our economy can develop. 

"Third, and I think most importantly, the rule of law can be upheld."

Lee said four principles must be adhered to when it comes to safeguarding national security: complying with the rule of law; protecting human rights and freedoms; maintaining openness; and properly coordinating development and security.


Edited by Edmond Fong

路透社引述歐盟外交官表示，歐盟27國很可能在對華貨物貿易逆差確實存在問題方面達成共識，認為需要採取進一步行動，但在應對措施方面存在分歧。法國主張採取更強硬立場，德國和西班牙則持較謹慎態度。預計歐盟領導人將要求歐盟執委會在加強貿易保護措施的同時，與中國開展對話。

西班牙首相桑切斯會前表示，歐洲需要朋友及平衡的關係，需要務實，與中美等主要經濟體建立聯繫。荷蘭首相耶滕則說，不確定各國能否達成協議，但認為就對華貿易失衡問題，以及如何提升歐盟自身競爭力對話，是件好事。

在北京，外交部早前表示，希望歐盟恪守公平競爭準則，避免搞保護主義措施。

title: Bulls return as strong dollar helps boost US stocks
news_content:
Wall Street stocks bounced back on Thursday, pivoting into buying mode after the pullback in the prior session prompted by a Federal Reserve policy outlook that signalled possible rate hikes ahead.

But the dollar continued to push higher in light of the Fed outlook, while oil prices were mixed as markets try to suss out when the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz will boost crude supply.

Briefing.com analyst Patrick O'Hare said Wednesday's equity market losses created an opportunity for bullish investors, calling the selloff "catnip for the buy-the-dip crowd" after hawkish elements of the Fed announcement rattled markets.

Major US indices had fallen about one percent or more on Wednesday after newly installed Fed Chair Kevin Warsh highlighted the central bank's commitment to price stability as the Fed released an updated outlook that raised the inflation forecast and projected a rate hike in 2026.

The broad-based S&P 500 finished up 1.1 percent at 7,500, the blue chip Dow rose 0.1 percent to 51,564, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq rose 1.9 percent to 26,517. (AFP)




Edited by Robert Kemp

title: 萬斯稱美伊都有履行備忘錄承諾　逾千萬桶原油已通過霍爾木茲海峽
news_content:
美國與伊朗簽署諒解備忘錄後，中央司令部表示，美軍解除所有進出伊朗港口和沿海地區的海上交通封鎖。副總統萬斯表示，已有1250萬桶原油通過霍爾木茲海峽，雙方在軍事上都有履行備忘錄中的承諾，伊朗連續兩晚沒有在海峽向任何船隻開火。

萬斯在白宮記者會又說，備忘錄中規定達成最終協議的60日期限，從星期四開始計算，他會在接下來的談判中領導美方團隊，技術談判預計本周末開始，最終協議將解決霍爾木茲海峽的長期營運問題，確保海峽永遠不會再成為全球經濟的樽頸，強調國際水道不應徵收通行費。他又說，自己仍計劃前往瑞士，具體時間待定。

另外，萬斯說，以色列在黎巴嫩的軍事行動有時阻礙美伊談判取得突破，讓總統特朗普感到沮喪。他重申以色列有權自衛，但同時敦促以方尊重這個對整個地區都有益的和平進程。

特朗普在社交平台說，期待所有戰線全面停火，鼓勵中東地區各方恪守承諾，讓美伊談判順利進行。

卡拉斯當地星期四在布魯塞爾出席歐盟峰會前說，美國與伊朗簽署諒解備忘錄，為緩和當前緊張局勢、推動霍爾木茲海峽重新開放提供基礎，但包括伊朗核問題在內的複雜議題，仍需在接下來60日內繼續談判。

卡拉斯又談及歐盟與以色列方面的分歧，指出歐盟在約旦河西岸定居者暴力及定居點擴張等問題上，一直對以色列持批評態度。約旦河西岸定居者的暴力行為正削弱「兩國方案」的實現前景，歐盟支持「兩國方案」，並要求人道主義援助進入加沙。

title: 烏總統稱再襲莫斯科煉油廠　俄外長稱將持續密集打擊烏軍相關目標
news_content:

俄羅斯國防部同日表示，防空系統過去一夜在莫斯科地區、別爾哥羅德州及布良斯克州等多地，攔截並摧毀超過550架烏克蘭無人機。另外，俄軍凌晨使用高精度武器及遠程攻擊無人機，對烏克蘭燃料能源綜合體設施實施集群打擊，回應烏方攻勢。外長拉夫羅夫說，俄方會把與烏克蘭武裝力量的相關設施設定為目標，持續密集打擊，作為烏克蘭當局對俄發動恐怖襲擊的回應。

烏克蘭空軍表示，俄軍自當地星期三傍晚起使用彈道導彈及約240架無人機襲擊烏克蘭。防空系統在北部、南部和東部擊落或壓制超過210個空中目標。

title: 美防長稱將審查美在歐軍事部署　要求歐洲承擔地區常規防務主責
news_content:

title: CE meets NPC, CPPCC members over 5-year plan
news_content:
Chief Executive John Lee met Hong Kong members of the National People's Congress (NPC) and the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) on Thursday to gather views on the city's first five-year plan.

A public consultation on the blueprint got under way this week and will last for two months.

Lee wrote on social media that the government would take a serious and pragmatic approach in consolidating feedback to formulate the five-year plan.

He said he expects NPC and CPPCC deputies to continue to promote the significance of the plan, while encouraging public participation in the consultation process.

Hong Kong's sole delegate to the NPC Standing Committee, Starry Lee, voiced support for the consultation document, particularly the part on developing the Northern Metropolis, as she described it is a key driver of Hong Kong's future economic growth.

title: 天文台稱暴雨與熱帶氣旋屬不同尺度天氣系統　提前預測暴雨屬挑戰
news_content:
天文台一日內兩度發生黑色暴雨警告信號。

天文台表示，下午初時影響本港的雷雨帶曾經遠離，本港雨勢一度減弱，因此曾改發紅色及黃色暴雨警告信號，但隨後在珠江口西邊的強雷雨區迅速發展，向東移動，影響香港，強度增強跡象，天文台於傍晚6時35分再度發出黑色暴雨警告信號。

署理高級科學主任莊思寧說，市民或有疑問，為何天文台可於數小時前預告熱帶氣旋警告訊號更改，但暴雨警告信號則不能，原因是熱帶氣旋與暴雨屬不同尺度的天氣系統。

她指出，熱帶氣旋生命周期可長達數日、而範圍達到幾百公里，但暴雨屬較小型系統，由發展到消散可能不足兩小時，影響範圍可能只有十至數十公里。

莊思寧說，以今日為例，新界普遍地區受大雨影響，相反港島雨勢較弱，因此要提前數小時、甚至一日以預測哪個位置或時間受暴雨影響，仍屬現今氣象界一大挑戰。她又說，隨著位於西北太平洋的副熱帶高壓脊向西伸展，廣東驟雨將會逐漸減少。



編輯：任順熙

title: 民政事務總署呼籲市民提防不法份子偽冒關愛隊

另外，關愛隊成員和義工在履行職務期間，會穿上關愛隊制服及配戴關愛隊小隊成員身份證或義工證明，以供識別。

title: Towngas to raise basic tariff starting Aug 1
news_content:
Towngas said it will raise basic tariff by 4.4 percent to HK$1.25 cents per megajoules (MJ) starting August 1.

At the same time, the fixed monthly maintenance charge will go up by HK$1 to HK$11.

Under the increment, the firm said about 65 percent of its residential customers will pay less than HK$10 extra per month, while half of its commercial and industrial users will pay an additional amount of less than 320 dollars each month.

Towngas also said both the basic tariff and maintenance charge will stay unchanged for the next two years.

The company said it has always been “exceedingly prudent” in tariff adjustments, and the decision came after considering the customers’ affordability.

“Over the past two years, operational expenses have continued to rise, alongside a marked increase in labour costs across the gas industry. Substantial capital investment will also be required in the forthcoming years to maintain safe and reliable services, as well as to extend town gas supply to newly developed areas, such as the Northern Metropolis,” a statement read.

“It is anticipated that the aggregate capital investment for 2026 and the subsequent five years will amount to HK$13.1 billion.”

About 41,000 beneficiaries, such as eligible elderly people and single-parent families, will continue to get a 50 percent discount for the first 500MJ of monthly town gas consumption, Towngas added, and their monthly maintenance fees and spare parts costs will continue to be waived.


Edited by Edmond Fong

title: 民航處處長廖志勇訪問北京　拜訪多個民航單位
news_content:
民航處處長廖志勇展開北京訪問行程，拜訪多個民航單位，就共同推動國家及香港航空業高質量發展作深入交流，進一步提升雙方在民用航空領域的協作效率及合作關係。

廖志勇拜訪中國民用航空局局長宋志勇，感謝民航局一直以來對香港航空業的關心及大力支持，並介紹香港民航業的發展近況，進一步加強雙方在民航領域的合作，配合國家「十五五」規劃，更好融入和推動民航高質量發展。

廖志勇亦與民航局空中交通管理局局長苗旋會面，探討強化雙方在航空交通管理上的協作，提升粵港澳大灣區的航空業運行效率，並促進亞太區航空交通管理的合作。

廖志勇明日將繼續訪問行程，其後會前往國家行政學院，出席民航處與香港民航業界管理層人員國情研習專班的開班儀式，參與首日的研修課程，與學員分享香港航空業如何主動對接國家「十五五」規劃， 為國家和香港的民航發展作出貢獻。

title: 莫斯科市長稱防空系統擊落大批施襲無人機　有煉油廠受損
news_content:
俄羅斯傳媒引述首都莫斯科市長索比亞寧公布的消息，指出自當地今日凌晨零時起，武裝部隊防空系統已擊落約200架襲擊莫斯科的無人機。莫斯科一間購物中心及一間煉油廠在襲擊中受損，防空系統仍在運作中，應對持續來襲的無人機。
　　
俄羅斯聯邦航空運輸署曾於今日較早時發聲明，對莫斯科四座機場實施升降限制。交通部最新通報指，當中的茹科夫斯基機場，正在與相關部門協調，為飛機提供後勤保障，其餘三座機場已恢復正常運作。報道指目前不清楚無人機襲擊在莫斯科市造成的人員傷亡情況。

烏克蘭總統澤連斯基早前在社交媒體上說，烏方一星期內對莫斯科煉油廠實施了兩次打擊，是對俄羅斯襲擊烏方城市及社區的回應。

title: 伊朗總統稱伊美簽諒解備忘展現互相尊重　指伊朗維護自身尊嚴
news_content:
伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚在社交媒體發文，表示伊朗與美國簽署的諒解備忘錄，展現互相尊重。帖文說這是一份歷史性文件，亦是來自強大伊朗的信息，即是和平將在相互尊重的環境中，得以實現。他又說伊朗在維護自身尊嚴與獨立的同時，始終堅定致力於全球和平，並推動地區發展與合作。帖文同時有佩澤希齊揚與美國總統特朗普共同簽名的諒解備忘錄英文版的配圖。

較早時，特朗普在法國出席七國集團峰會期間表示，如果伊方違反協議，美方將對伊朗進行猛烈轟炸，他不希望見到這種情況，希望伊方能遵守協議。對於美伊談判代表正就在未來60日內達成永久停火協議展開協商，特朗普形容伊朗人「聰明」，期望此舉能為中東帶來和平，同時穩定國際油價。

title: 煤氣公司：8月起上調標準煤氣收費4.4%
news_content:
煤氣公司宣布，由8月1日起，標準煤氣收費每兆焦耳調高1.25仙，加幅4.4%；定額保養月費增加1元，升至11元。煤氣公司表示，兩年內不會調整標準煤氣收費及保養月費。

今次費用調整後，約6成半住宅用戶每月煤氣帳單加幅不會多於10元，約5成工商業用戶，每月煤氣費會增加少於320元。

煤氣公司表示，一直對調整收費十分謹慎，由於過去兩年營運成本增加，燃氣行業人力成本上升，未來數年須投入龐大資本投資以維持安全可靠的服務，以及為北部都會區等新發展地區供氣，預計今年及未來5年的資本投資總額將達131億元，經充分考慮客戶承受能力，作出溫和的收費調整。

煤氣公司會繼續為約4.1萬個合資格長者、殘疾人士、低收入及單親家庭提供優惠，他們將繼續享有每月首500兆焦耳的煤氣用量半價優惠，並獲豁免保養月費和零件費用。

公司表示，自2006年10月起引入天然氣作為生產燃氣的部分原料，至今為客戶節省約243億元燃料費用，並透過燃料調整費機制全數回饋用戶。去年平均實質煤氣費較2006年9月高15%，而同期累計通脹率約62%。


編輯：羅煒皓

title: 美伊簽諒解備忘共14點內容　包括立即並永久停所有戰線軍事行動

另外，美國將立即著手解除對伊朗的海上封鎖，及針對伊朗的任何干擾或阻礙行為。伊朗將盡最大努力作出安排，確保商船在60天期限內，免費安全往返於波斯灣與阿曼灣之間。

title: 李家超出席港區人大及政協委員諮詢會　李慧琼稱認同五年規劃內容
news_content:
行政長官李家超下午分別出席港區全國人大代表和港區全國政協委員的香港五年規劃諮詢會，聽取他們就規劃提出的建議。

全國人大常委、立法會主席李慧琼見記者時表示，總體非常認同諮詢文件的内容，尤其是發展北都的部分。她說，北都是香港未來經濟發展重要引擎，需透過提速提效建設、引入創科以至更多科研落戶香港，讓香港可為國家科技自立自強貢獻力量。她相信智慧在民間，呼籲社會各界積極提出意見。

被問到五年規劃橫跨政府換屆，交接工作會否有困難，港區全國人大代表、立法會議員陳勇說，國家每一次五年規劃都是「一張藍圖做到底」，又指正因五年規劃跨越政府換屆，可以將好的規劃延續至下屆政府，不會因換屆而有變化，每一屆政府的施政報告將藍圖逐步落實。

title: 將軍澳醫院造口手術事故　根源報告指醫生分辨腹部器官出現偏誤
news_content:
將軍澳醫院一名患結腸癌85歲女病人，今年2月進行橫結腸造口手術緩解腸阻塞，原定造口位置在橫結腸，其後被發現造口在胃部，病人在3月離世。

院方公布事件根源分析報告，根源分析委員會調查事件成因後，認為外科醫生在分辨腹部器官結構時出現確認偏誤，在手術中錯誤將胃部當作橫結腸處理，並連接造口，手術中亦未採取進一步措施核實。病人在轉院前兩日，醫護人員未有察覺造口輸出量已有上升趨勢，按原定計劃將病人轉往接受康復治療。負責康復治療的醫護人員，對於剛完成造口手術的病人，缺乏相關照顧經驗。外科與康復治療團隊之間溝通不足，未有適時監察及確認病人造口輸出量的異常情況，以致未有重新評估和及早介入。  

委員會提出3項改善建議，包括檢視外科部門的臨床管治，特別是負責督導有關手術的外科專科醫生，在手術過程中所作的臨床決定，以及在術後將出現不尋常臨床情況的病人，轉往內科復康設施治療的安排；術後病人在轉往接受康復治療後，應加強外科團隊在治療過程中的參與；以及制訂機制，安排造口專科護士為剛完成造口手術病人進行評估，妥善記錄病人攝取水份及造口輸出量，確保病人的臨床情況得以適時向外科團隊報告。  

院方接納報告建議，並已實行有關改善措施，提升病人安全，包括檢視手術決策、轉院安排及跨團隊溝通的臨床管治機制；造口專科護士評估剛接受造口手術病人的制度亦已標準化，並加強與外科團隊的溝通。

發言人表示，院方並非常重視事件，早前已將個案轉交死因裁判官跟進，並將事件列為醫療風險警示事件。醫院病人關係組已聯絡病人家屬詳細解釋報告結果，再次向他們致歉，並會繼續為家屬提供所需協助。

title: 陳國基：須摒棄單向金錢援助舊思維　轉向主動識別精準輔助新模式
news_content:
政府公布《香港精準扶貧成果報告》，政務司司長陳國基表示，必須要摒棄單向金錢援助的舊思維，轉向主動識別、精準輔助這新模式，通過整合數據主動識別最有需要幫助群體，透過精準扶助、即所謂「隊尾」人士，提供有針對性的綜合支援。

陳國基說，明白社會上有處於「隊尾」人士正面對不同挑戰，例如有經濟或照顧與關懷需要，因此扶貧委員會在既有保障基礎上，鎖定三個目標群組包括劏房住戶、單親住戶及全長者住戶，「度身定做」針對性項目。

他又說，將「政、商、民」三方攜手扶弱模式制度化，鼓勵創新、多元、精準到位的扶助項目。政府未來會以社區為主場、以家庭為載體，加強跨界別、跨專業、跨世代協作，擴大服務覆蓋面，適時考慮辨別更多目標群組，讓精準幫助延伸至每個有需要角落。

被問到如何定義貧窮，陳國基指出，貧窮不應單以經濟角度評估，應涵蓋非經濟上的貧窮，政府可從生活空間、情緒支援等提出全方位幫助，這屬今次提出精準扶貧的重點，形容有關定義範圍闊。

陳國基認為，政府的「兜底」政策例如綜緩，可讓有需要市民的基本生活得到保障。他又說，社會每次出現新轉變，都有新的群組需要，如果政府全部都要幫手，將不斷有人要求幫助，強調政府不會停止提供服務的工作。

被問到本港目前的貧窮情況、如何介定減貧目標，勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡回應，以往的「貧窮線」屬統計數字，只參考「相對收入」這指標，未能顯示在甚麼人士或範疇出現貧窮情況。他強調，精準扶貧措施是以人為本，「有血有肉」針對有關需要去做，要有好的工具，更好對焦社會需要。

title: HK places second in global competitiveness ranking
news_content:
Hong Kong has risen to second place in global competitiveness in a worldwide ranking, gaining ground for a third consecutive year to its highest placing since 2019. 

Published by the International Institute for Management Development, the World Competitiveness Yearbook measures the capabilities of an economy based on four main factors, namely economic performance, government efficiency, business efficiency and infrastructure. 

The SAR ranked second globally in government efficiency and third in business efficiency, and placed eighth and 11th in infrastructure and economic performance, respectively. 

As for various sub-factors, it topped the chart in tax policy and business legislation, was second in finance, and placed third in terms of international trade, international investment, management practices and education. 

In a statement, a government spokesman said the rankings reaffirmed Hong Kong's position as one of the most competitive economies in the world and that the SAR's rise to second globally sustains the strong upward trajectory made in 2024 and 2025. 

"Amid rapidly evolving geopolitical dynamics, Hong Kong, with its close connectivity to both the Chinese mainland and the world under the 'one country, two systems' principle, and its sound institutions, open markets and sustained investments in innovation, has become a 'value hub' that offers both security and growth opportunities," he said. 

"Hong Kong continues to excel in various international rankings including those for economy, finance and talent." 

The spokesman also said the administration will work together with all sectors of society to strengthen the city's role and function as a "super connector" and "super value-adder", with a view towards better integrating into and serving overall national development, and open up new opportunities for global investors and enterprises.


Edited by Edmond Fong

李家超表示，隨着市場對人民幣計價產品和相關避險金融工具的需求日增，在香港推出國債期貨是一個重要的發展里程碑，為投資者提供有效的離岸風險管理工具，投資者能更高效地管理利率風險敞口，進一步吸引國際投資者參與內地債券市場並長期持有人民幣國債，促進國債市場的健康發展，進一步鞏固香港債券中心地位。

財政司司長陳茂波表示，在港推出國債期貨，增添一項離岸風險管理產品，讓國際投資者管理人民幣利率風險的對沖工具更為完整，有助提升國債流動性和市場深度，吸引更多全球資金參與內地國債市場。國債期貨是完善香港人民幣產品生態圈和深化互聯互通的關鍵一步，有利帶動結構性產品、資產管理及風險管理服務在港發展，鞏固香港作為全球領先離岸人民幣樞紐和國際風險管理中心的地位。

title: US rate fears feed HK losses despite regional surge
news_content:
Tech shares rallied in the mainland on Thursday as investors cheered the securities regulator's pledge to support innovation while Hong Kong stocks fell on US rate hike prospects.

In Hong Kong, the benchmark Hang Seng Index ended 387 points, or 1.59 percent, lower to 23,924.

The tech index was 64 points, or 1.39 percent, lower at 4,604 while the China enterprises index was 167 points, or 2.06 percent, down at 7,976.

Hong Kong tracked losses on Wall Street as investors bet the US Federal Reserve's next move would be a rate hike.

The Fed held rates steady on Wednesday, but new quarterly projections showed nine of its 19 officials anticipating a hike by the end of 2026.

"We expect Asian markets to initially follow the US in reacting to the risk of higher rates," said Tai Hui, APAC chief market strategist at JP Morgan Asset Management.

"That said, with a US-Iran deal on the horizon, investors would interpret the Fed's hawkishness as precautionary, which should help reverse the US dollar's strength and be more supportive of Asian equities."

On the mainland, the Shanghai Composite Index ended 17 points, or 0.43 percent, lower at 4,090 on turnover of 1.56 trillion yuan. 

The Shenzhen Component Index rose 149 points, or 0.94 percent, to 16,030 on turnover of 1.75 trillion yuan. 

The start-up board ChiNext Index climbed 85 points, or 2.05 percent, to close at 4,252, a record closing high, on turnover of 862.18 billion yuan.

The gains came as Beijing said on Wednesday it would support listings of startups in "future industries" such as quantum technology, nuclear fusion and brain-computer interfaces.

The tech-focused Star 50 leapt 3.8 percent to notch a record close.

"A new wave of technological revolution, led by AI, is being integrated into production and daily life at an unprecedented pace," said Wu Qing, chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, at a forum in Shanghai.

Stocks in traditional sectors sold off. A sub-index tracking banking shares lost 2.6 percent, while property shares dropped 2.8 percent.

In Tokyo, the Nikkei share gauge surged 1,151 points, or 1.65 percent, past the key 71,000 level for the first time to end at 71,053 after touching an intraday high of 71,398.58. The broader Topix gained almost 55 points, or 1.37 percent, to hit 4,068, also an all-time high.

In Seoul, the benchmark Kospi too rocketed up 199 points, or 2.25 percent, to top the 9,000 milestone for the first time, finishing at 9,063 as chipmakers hit record highs on AI optimism.

Hong Kong and mainland markets will be closed on Friday for the Dragon Boat Festival. (Reuters & Xinhua)

title: 陳茂波繼續上海訪問　深化滬港兩地金融創科及經貿等合作
news_content:
財政司司長陳茂波繼續在上海的訪問行程，深化滬港兩地在金融、創科及經貿等領域的合作，進一步發揮香港作為「超級聯繫人」和「超級增值人」的角色。

陳茂波與中國證券監督委員會主席吳清會面。雙方就繼續支持內地企業來港上市、優化內地與香港資本市場互聯互通機制，以及推進兩地金融監管合作等議題交流。

其後，陳茂波到訪上海黃金交易所，與理事長余文建會面，就滬港兩地黃金市場的合作協同發展交換意見。隨後，他到訪浦發銀行，與董事長張為忠會面，重點討論推進兩地金融合作，尤其是支持金融更好服務內地企業拓展海外業務，以及賦能科創生態圈。

陳茂波亦到訪兩家在人工智能領域的領軍企業。其中一家專注於分佈式人工智能雲計算服務，並已在香港設立境外總部，為海外用戶提供算力服務；另一家則致力於開發新一代光子計算芯片，以「光計算」技術突破算力瓶頸。

陳茂波下午結束上海行程，轉抵南京繼續訪問。傍晚他將與江蘇省常務副省長馬欣會面，就深化蘇港合作交流意見，明日將繼續在南京的訪問行程。



編輯：任順熙

title: 渠務署確認13宗水浸個案　已完成清理8宗
news_content:
渠務署表示，截至下午4時，共確認13宗水浸個案，分別位於新田永平村、坪輋李屋、粉錦公路、屯門法院、坪輋塘坊村、上璋圍、流浮山輞井村、屯門亦園路附近地盤、羅湖得月樓停車場、蓮麻坑路、屯門井頭村、屯門山景邨及天水圍天福路。經渠務署緊急應變隊伍的協助下，目前已完成清理8宗水浸個案，署方正全力處理其他水浸個案。

title: 港交所與金管局研究以數碼港元　支付衍生產品收市後交易預繳按金
news_content:
港交所與金管局公布，推出一項聯合試點項目，研究在衍生產品市場收市後交易時段提供新的數碼支付方案，優化香港資本市場，滿足市場對收市後交易時段持續增長的需求。

港交所與金管局正研究引入「數碼港元」，即採用24/7運作模式的批發層面央行數碼貨幣（CBDC），用於支付收市後交易時段的預繳按金，提升衍生產品市場在銀行營業時段以外的風險管理能力，同時維持現有作業流程不變。

試點項目將為預繳按金支付安排提供更高靈活性及效率，目前結算參與者如欲存入預繳按金，必須於下午3時前向香港期貨結算公司提交申請，款項方可用於收市後交易時段。

港交所正邀請期貨結算公司轄下的結算參與者進行自願性質的試行真實交易，更廣泛應用則要視乎監管審批，市場準備情況及其他因素。

港交所首席營運總監劉碧茵表示，今次合作進一步提升香港資本市場基礎設施便利性，希望在一般營業時間以外提供更靈活和及時的支付選項，回應業界長期面對的營運痛點。

金管局副總裁李達志表示，今次聯合試點項目，展示CBDC在真實市場環境中的應用，亦突顯金管局與行業持份者在推動金融創新方面的緊密合作關係。



編輯：張詩民

title: 證監會：本港8月3日推出五年期國債期貨
news_content:
香港證監會宣布，本港計劃於8月3日推出五年期國債期貨。證監會表示，經評估市場需求及宏觀環境後，五年期國債被選為首先在香港交易所買賣的國債期貨合約資產。

當局指，近年國際投資者穩步增持中國國債，尤其是通過債券通，截至5月底，外國投資者持有約2萬億元人民幣中國國債，在港推出國債期貨將為國際投資者提供有效的離岸對沖工具，滿足日益增加的國債風險管理需求，便利投資者進一步參與內地國債市場，加強香港作為離岸人民幣中心及人民幣資產風險管理樞紐的角色。

行政總裁梁鳳儀表示，國債期貨推出，適逢資產管理公司構建多元化策略，對人民幣計價固定收益資產的投資需求增加，同時彰顯香港作為區域內固定收益及離岸人民幣樞紐的關鍵角色。

主席黃天祐則指，推出國債期貨是香港在金融領域對接國家「十五五」規劃、進一步推進與內地金融市場互聯互通的重大舉措，是香港助力人民幣國際化，發展為全球固定收益及貨幣市場中心的里程碑。

港交所主席唐家成表示，將繼續與業務夥伴緊密合作，進一步促進中國與國際市場的雙向資本流動。行政總裁陳翊庭則指，國債期貨作為債券通的重要補充，將和互換通一起為境外投資者提供高效的風險管理工具，支持香港市場人民幣產品生態圈發展。

港交所指，將適時公布產品詳情。



編輯：張詩民

title: Targeted poverty alleviation strategy hailed a success
news_content:
The government has hailed its targeted poverty alleviation strategy a success, saying its three flagship initiatives have met or exceeded all performance indicators. 

An impact report released on Thursday showed major improvements in household incomes and living conditions for the most vulnerable groups. 

Introduced in 2022, the targeted poverty alleviation strategy currently focuses resources on three vulnerable groups: single parents, elderly households, and those living in subdivided flats.

However, looking ahead, the administration is planning to shift its approach. 

A government source said officials intend to add a fourth targeted group to the scheme, though no details were given on who would be included.

The source revealed that the government does not plan to reintroduce a formal poverty line, say that setting a single income threshold is not the most effective way to design policy measures to fight poverty.

Officials will also stop defining what “poverty” is to avoid labelling those in need, the source added. 

The government is set to launch a digital matching platform designed to better align business sector resources with community welfare projects this year. 

A research team at the Polytechnic University, commissioned by the administration, conducted a study and found that the three main initiatives under the targeted poverty alleviation strategy have yielded major benefits. 

Under the School-based After School Care Scheme, 70 percent of parents felt their caregiving pressures had eased, while the support allowed more homemakers to return to work – boosting average monthly household incomes for those participating in the scheme by about HK$3,500.

The Pilot Programme on Community Living Room – which provides shared kitchens, as well as study and living spaces for subdivided unit residents – also scored highly, with 95 percent of users saying the initiative improved their living conditions and social connections.

Meanwhile, the Strive and Rise Programme – which pairs underprivileged secondary school students with volunteer mentors – saw over 90 percent of students report gains in at least one of eight key areas, such as self-esteem, financial planning, and goal setting.

On the ground, district services and community care teams made contact with around 110,000 households in need. 

Their outreach led to more than 13,000 service referrals, including over 3,500 emergency alarm installations. Care teams also visited nearly 35,000 high-risk households, transferring more than 2,400 vulnerable cases to social welfare units.


Edited by Aaron Tam

title: 陳國基稱扶貧措施須因時制宜　消息：不再定義貧窮需關注目標群組
news_content:
扶貧委員會公布《香港精準扶貧成果報告》，提及過去使用的「貧窮線」指標只捕捉住戶當期現金收入，未完全考慮其持有資產與負債情況，令貧窮人口被高估，亦無法全面涵蓋政府提供的重大非現金福利，例如公共醫療服務、免費基礎教育等，難以精準識別最需要支援的群體。政府消息人士表示，不再定義何謂貧窮，而是關注有需要的目標群組，包括劏房戶、單親住戶及全長者住戶的需求，他們有時不只需要現金援助，亦有心理及社交等需要，而以往使用的「貧窮線」未能反映有關情況，預計今年內會再有多一個目標群組，期望更精準支援他們。

政務司司長陳國基表示，精準扶貧是本屆政府的策略，務求將資源更準確及有效投放有需要人士身上。他說，扶貧政策措施需要因時制宜，才能精準到位，單憑貧窮人口數字無法解答哪些人才是貧窮、哪些人最需要幫助等問題，做不到對症下藥。扶貧重點是要知道哪些人士及哪些群組最需要幫助，他們的具體需要、及如何協助他們。

報告剖析政府在教育、醫療、房屋、社會福利及就業服務四個政策範疇的常設措施，並將政府代家庭承擔的開支、即家庭獲得的公共服務，量化為「社會資源價值」，例如居於出租公屋並領取長者生活津貼的雙老家庭，平均每月可以獲得的房屋、醫療及社福現金資源總值達24500元。政府消息人士指，社會資源價值是平均數，期待讓市民了解服務的價值及政府在扶貧工作上的力度。

報告顯示，受惠於「在校課後託管服務計劃」的家長中，97%表示計劃改善因個人和家庭責任而影響工作表現的情況、減輕與子女的磨擦等，而家庭在參加計劃後，每月平均收入增約3500元。而共創明「Teen」計劃，逾九成學員至少一項指標獲提升；「社區客廳試行計劃」逾95%會員表示生活空間、社區歸屬感有改善。



編輯：任順熙

title: 本港二手樓價按星期升約0.6%　連升3周
news_content:
反映本港二手樓價走勢的中原城市領先指數（CCL）最新報159.04，按周升0.58%，連升3周共1.01%，再創逾兩年半新高。CCL今年累計上升10.36%。

大型屋苑及中小型單位指數分別升0.56%和0.68%，均創逾兩年半新高。大型單位微升0.08%，連升兩周共1.73%。

4區樓價中，港島升1.2%，結束連續3周跌勢。新界東升0.75%，連升兩周共2.01%，新界西升0.79%，新界東及新界西均創逾兩年半新高。九龍微跌0.12%，連升兩周後回軟。

中原地產表示，港元1個月同業拆息HIBOR回升至近3厘，美國聯儲局加息預期升溫，好淡消息交錯，或影響第三季後期樓價升幅可能減慢。



編輯：張詩民

title: 港股低收387點　創近一年收市新低　恒指本周累跌逾3%
news_content:
港股失守24000點，創近一年收市新低。恒生指數一度跌逾560點，低見23749點，收市報23924點，跌387點，跌幅1.59%。主板成交額逾3587億元，較上日急升近33%。

科技指數收報4604點，跌幅1.39%。ATMXJ跌逾1%至逾3%，以美團及小米跌幅較大。

晶片、人工智能相關股份造好，智譜急升逾26%，MINIMAX升逾12%，是表現最好兩隻科指成份股。華虹宏力升近6%。

內房及內險股急挫，中人壽、龍湖、華潤置地及中海外跌近7%至近9%，是表現最差4隻藍籌股。

醫藥股逆市造好，藥明生物、百濟神州及藥明康德升逾3%至5%，是表現最好3隻藍籌股。

恒指本周累計跌3.2%，科指累計跌2.1%。



編輯：張詩民

title: 精準扶貧報告公布　倡設配對平台促進商界資源與民間社福項目對接
news_content:
扶貧委員會公布《香港精準扶貧成果報告》，指出在政、商、民三方合力推動和實踐下，精準扶貧項目的所有關鍵績效指標（KPI）均已達成，部分更超越預期。未來應摒棄過往單從「接濟」角度出發，轉向「主動識別、精準扶助」，會將政、商、民三方合作模式制度化，設立一個配對平台，促進商界資源與民間社會福利項目精準對接，鼓勵創新多元精準的扶助項目，提升目標群組的幸福感、安全感及獲得感。政府消息人士表示，正進行平台的籌備工作，預計今年下半年推出。

報告超過220頁，分五章說明香港精準扶貧成果，圖文並茂列出50個故事及30個用家分享。提及2026/27財政年度，政府投放於教育、醫療衞生和社會福利方面的預算經常開支逾3500億元，佔政府整體經常開支約六成。報告形容，普惠社會的服務發揮「兜底保障」、「造血賦能」的功能，惠及絕大多數市民。分析不同社會經濟特徵的住戶群組後，進一步鎖定最有需要幫助的目標群組，因應需要推出精準扶貧項目，不應只局限於為基層家庭提供經濟支援，而在於全面回應他們的身心、社交和發展等需要。

報告形容，單靠政府資源不足以全面應對日益複雜的社會挑戰，將以深化政、商、民三方合作為核心策略，推動協作模式走向更制度化、更可持續方向。政府聚焦提供「兜底保障」、規則制定與資源配置；商界與社會提供資金、場地、科技應用與人才等方面的支持；民間或社福機構則提供專業服務、執行任務。通過積極引導社會力量，全面推動關愛文化，讓不同界別、背景和年齡的人都有機會參與地區關愛工作。



編輯：任順熙

title: Man arrested in HK$14.5mn cannabis bust at airport
news_content:
Hong Kong Customs said they seized about 81 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds at the airport worth around HK$14.5 million, and arrested a local male passenger.

The suspect, who travelled from Thailand, was stopped by officers during a baggage check. 

Customs inspector Teresa Chan said they discovered the drugs in the suspect's luggage after an X-ray scan.

"We found [the] suspected cannabis buds inside the clothes," she said.

Senior investigator of Drug Investigation Division 1, Chan Kit-lun said the department has adopted new risk-assessment methods and advanced technology to detect suspicious consignments. 

Chan said they have not ruled out further arrests connected to the seizure.


Edited by Aaron Tam

title: 李家超下周一率團訪問福建出席閩港高層會晤
news_content:
行政長官李家超將於下周一率團訪問福建，出席閩港高層會晤暨閩港合作會議第五次會議。

會議下周一在福州舉行，閩港雙方會就多個重點領域深入交流意見，進一步深化合作。訪問期間，李家超會與福建省、市領導會面，參觀當地創科企業和文化項目。
 
政務司司長陳國基和行政長官辦公室主任葉文娟將隨團訪問。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇、民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟、文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩和政制及內地事務局局長謝小華等官員會參與行程相關部分。
　　
李家超將於6月24日回港。他離港期間，財政司司長陳茂波將於6月22日至當日下午署理行政長官職務；律政司司長林定國將於6月22日傍晚至24日署理行政長官職務。

title: 中方歡迎美伊簽首階段諒解備忘　冀各方秉持契約精神兌現承諾
news_content:
在北京，外交部發言人林劍表示，美伊雙方簽署第一階段諒解備忘錄，對緩和局勢緊張、鞏固停火勢頭有積極意義，中方表示歡迎，希望包括美伊在內的相關各方，都能秉持契約精神，切實兌現承諾。

在例行記者會上，林劍回應有關美伊簽署諒解備忘錄的提問又指出，武力解決不了問題，平等談判才是正道，中方希望美伊雙方都能以理性務實態度，對待第二階段談判，相向而行，共同努力，爭取下階段談判取得積極成果。

林劍說，中方一貫支援中東海灣地區實現和平與穩定，又指中國與伊朗是全面戰略伙伴，中方願意與伊方鞏固及深化政治互信，深化各領域的互利合作，繼續推進中伊全面戰略夥伴關係。


編輯：羅宇光

title: 文錦渡口岸部分設施水浸　需暫停旅客及貨運清關服務
news_content:
​特區政府接獲深圳有關當局通知，文錦渡口岸因暴雨引致口岸區域積水，部分設施水浸，為保障旅客及設施安全，口岸需暫時停止旅客及貨運清關服務，直至另行通知。

跨境旅客和車輛可使用其他陸路口岸往返內地，並應在起程前預早計劃行程及了解最新的交通及公共運輸服務情況。特區政府會靈活調配人手，疏導各口岸交通及人流。

title: 國際應急與航空醫療交流會議結束　聯合演練模擬恐襲下救援工作
news_content:
政府飛行服務隊舉辦一連3日的「國際應急與航空醫療交流會議」今日圓滿結束。政府飛行服務隊總監廖嘉俊指，政府飛行服務隊在應急救援方面一直擔當重要角色，除了協助搜救、提供空中救護及其他緊急航空醫療服務外，亦肩負香港特區内部保安的責任，在緊急事故例如恐怖襲擊中，透過快速機動的部署，協助紀律部隊進行空中突擊，全方位支援特區政府的整體反恐工作。

今日的交流移師至部隊的啟德分部，政府飛行服務隊聯同警務處和消防處進行跨部門反恐演練，模擬有恐怖分子於多處重要基建設施和旅遊景點放置炸彈，企圖發動恐襲，同黨更挾持一艘客船，在船上與警方爆發槍戰。政府飛行服務隊出動直升機協助警方登上船隻，並派遣人員拯救被槍傷的傷者，展示部門在緊急救援任務中所擔當的角色。在警方安全處理土製炸彈後，消防處派遣人員阻止危害物質擴散，並設立「洗消設施」為受污染人士進行清洗。 

今次交流會議匯聚逾230位政府官員、決策人員、專家學者和機構代表，共同探討航空醫療與緊急應變的最新發展及未來方向，彰顯香港作為亞洲應急航空樞紐的地位。



編輯：黃佩珊

title: 香港在《2026年世界競爭力年報》排名上升至全球第二位
news_content:
財政司司長辦公室表示，香港在國際管理發展學院最新發布的《2026年世界競爭力年報》排名連續三年上升，今年上升一位至全球第二位，是2019年以來最高。
 
年報的四個競爭力因素中，香港在「政府效率」排名第二、「營商效率」全球第三；「基礎建設」和「經濟表現」分別排名全球第八和第十一。

多個競爭力子因素，香港在「稅務政策」和「商業法規」排名全球第一；「金融」排名全球第二；「國際貿易」、「國際投資」、「管理方式」和「教育」排名全球第三；「公共財政」和「基本基礎設施」排名全球第四。

政府發言人表示，再次肯定香港為全球最具競爭力經濟體之一，香港排名升至全球第二位，延續強勁上升軌道。競爭力因素中「政府效率」繼續位列全球第二，反映政府持續推動自由開放、穩定、可預期和營商友善的經濟政策，亦反映國際間對香港在法律和監管環境方面的信任。

發言人說，香港「營商效率」獲評為世界第三，反映金融業的蓬勃生態為產業發展提供有力支持，亦反映香港與國際最佳標準無縫對接的商業做法和營商環境。

發言人又說，香港正制定首份五年規劃，積極對接國家「十五五」規劃，政府將與各界努力，更好融入並服務國家發展大局，創造更多新的發展空間，為全球投資者及企業創造新機遇。

title: Lending rates remain unchanged at top HK banks
news_content:
Major commercial banks in the SAR announced on Thursday they are keeping their prime lending rates unchanged.

That came after the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) left its base rate unchanged at four percent, hours after the US Federal Reserve held its target rates steady in its first policy meeting under the new chairman, Kevin Warsh.

Following the HKMA move, HSBC and Bank of China (Hong Kong) announced that they were keeping their prime lending rates at five percent, while Standard Chartered said it'll hold its prime lending rate steady at 5.25 percent.

In a statement, the HKMA said the decision by the Fed is in line with market expectations and noted that policymakers at the US central bank are "watchful" over the inflation outlook, indicating the potential for price increases "remained elevated" in the country.

"US interest rate adjustments will depend on developments in inflation, labour market, and other economic data, and may influence the interest rate environment in Hong Kong," the HKMA said.

"The public should carefully manage interest rate risks when making decisions about property purchase, investment or borrowing." 

The authority also reiterated that the city's monetary and financial markets have continued to operate in an orderly manner and that it will continue to monitor the market developments.

Under the linked exchange rate system, Hong Kong dollar interbank rates generally track their US dollar counterparts, but the shorter-tenor interbank rates could also be affected by the supply and demand of Hong Kong dollar-denominated funding activities in the local market, such as seasonal factors and capital market activities, the HKMA added.

Earlier, the US Fed had maintained its target rate range at 3.5 percent to 3.75 percent following the fourth meeting of its policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee this year, with votes being unanimous for the first time in one year.

The policy meeting also marked the first by Warsh, who has vowed wide-ranging reforms at the US central bank, as the new Fed chairman.

While the rate-setting committee held rates steady this time, it projected a rate hike by year-end to counter surging inflation.




Edited by Azam Khan

title: 分析料聯儲局或9月加息

東亞銀行首席經濟師卓亮亦預計，聯儲局可能在9月或10月加息，但不認為已形成加息周期，港元拆息有跟隨美息上升的空間，最優惠利率就要視乎當時本港資金環境而定。

房委會資助房屋小組委員會通過將「未補價資助出售房屋出租計劃」，擴展至合資格白表申請者，以先導形式提供3000個名額。另外，亦通過推行「長者業主樓換樓計劃」，兩項計劃由房協管理，9月接受申請。

小組委員會主席張仁良會後見傳媒時表示，兩項計劃是希望打破未補價資助出售單位，在出租和出售上的限制，全方位活化現有的房屋資源，除了為中低收入家庭提供更多租盤選擇外，亦加強資助出售單位的流轉，協助年長業主安享晚年，為業主、租客和市民創造多贏局面。

被問到計劃向業主收取出租准許費，會否令業主改以「黑市」形式出租，以逃避相關費用。張仁良說，由於居屋在未補價的情況下出租，政府向業主收取出租准許費，是希望取回政府資助部分的費用，他不認為收費會導致「黑市」出租情況出現，因非法出租單位是犯法，過往亦有成功檢控的個案，被控的業主要負上刑責，所以今次計劃反而是令業主可以名正言順出租單位，令他們不必擔驚受怕，希望可以防止或制止非法出租情況。

張仁良又認為，將計劃名額設為3000個，將可以令租務市場多了3000個單位，供應多了，對租金亦有幫助。他又說，合資格可以參與計劃的資助出售房屋單位有36萬個，因此房委會持續檢視，包括了解計劃的受歡迎程度，以及審批時間是否可以再縮短，加快流通量。

title: Two schemes approved to enrich housing ladder
news_content:
The Housing Authority on Thursday approved two schemes aimed at enriching the housing ladder, as stated in the Chief Executive's 2025 Policy Address. 

A pilot scheme will be introduced to allow those who have owned a subsidised-sale flat for ten years or more to let their units with unpaid premium to eligible white form applicants – non-homeowners who pass asset-limit tests – after paying relevant fees. 

Eligible owners and potential tenants can apply for a HK$400 certificate during the application period, then identify suitable matches through an information sharing platform or via property agents. 

Tenants must then apply for another HK$400 "Nomination Certificate" from the authority or the Housing Society before entering a tenancy agreement, and owners would have to pay a Letting Permit Fee on a quarterly basis. 

The quota has been set at 3,000, and the authority will monitor the implementation of the programme and review its effectiveness. 

The authority will also launch the Flat for Flat Pilot Scheme for Elderly Owners, allowing those who are 60 or older who have owned their subsidised-sale flat for a decade or more to purchase a smaller unit or one that is located in a more remote area with premium unpaid, after selling their original one in the secondary market. 

Speaking to reporters after a meeting, authority member Stephen Cheung said these moves will help revitalise existing housing resources and provide more rental options for low and middle-income families.

When asked whether the Letting Permit Fee would give rise to a black market, Cheung said the fees are aimed at recouping the costs of the government subsidy, and it would instead help to prevent and curb illegal rental situations. 

"In the past few years, we have seen cases being prosecuted, and homeowners who rent out their flats illegally have to bear legal liability, such as paying a fine and even imprisonment," Cheung said. 

"So our scheme is actually helping homeowners to legally rent out their apartments," he added. 

Both schemes will be open for applications in September. 


Edited by Aaron Tam

title: Black Rainstorm Warning in effect for 2 hours
news_content:
The year's second Black Rainstorm Warning was in effect for more than two hours on Thursday as heavy rain lashed the region.

The black signal was issued at 12.55pm, replacing the red signal which had been in force for 45 minutes.

"This means that heavy rain has fallen or is expected to fall generally over Hong Kong, exceeding 70 millimetres in an hour, and is likely to continue," the Observatory said.

It was in effect until 3.05pm when the Red Rainstorm Warning was issued.

The Observatory warned that further heavy rain could cause or might already have caused serious flooding and traffic congestion, and people who have to travel should take necessary precautions.

The Observatory also warned that heavy rain will bring flash floods, with watercourses hit by flooding.

Members of the public are urged to stay away from watercourses.

A Special Announcement on Flooding in the northern New Territories was also issued earlier, with rain especially heavy in Yuen Long, Sheung Shui and Ta Kwu Ling.

The Social Welfare Department said that childcare and elderly service centres, as well as rehabilitation service units and vocational training centres will remain open during their normal operating hours to take care of those in need.

The Education Bureau announced that students of afternoon schools do not have to attend classes on Thursday. It added that classes of evening schools will proceed as usual if no red or black signal was in force by 5pm.

title: Observatory issues black rainstorm warning
news_content:
The Observatory issued its second Black Rainstorm Warning Signal this year as heavy rain continued to lash the region.

The black signal was issued at 12.55pm on Thursday, replacing the red signal which had been in force for 45 minutes.

"This means that heavy rain has fallen or is expected to fall generally over Hong Kong, exceeding 70 millimetres in an hour, and is likely to continue," the Observatory said.

Two amber signals were also issued on Thursday morning.

Members of the public are advised to take shelter in a safe place, and avoid travelling until conditions improve.

A Special Announcement on Flooding in the northern New Territories was also issued earlier, with rain especially heavy in Yuen Long, Sheung Shui and Ta Kwu Ling.

The Social Welfare Department said that childcare and elderly service centres, as well as rehabilitation service units and vocational training centres will remain open during their normal operating hours to take care of those in need.

The Education Bureau announced that students of afternoon schools do not have to attend classes today. It added that classes of evening schools will proceed as usual on Thursday night if no red or black signal was in force by 5pm.

攪珠及電腦抽籤程序完成後，申請人可即時以申請編號及身份證號碼於食環署網頁（www.fehd.gov.hk）查核抽籤結果。署方亦會以WhatsApp／流動電話短訊、電郵或郵寄方式，通知中籤申請人獲編配的特定骨灰龕位編號。申請人亦可在攪珠及電腦抽籤當日起，親臨食環署港島或九龍墳場及火葬場辦事處、公眾骨灰龕位編配辦事處，或致電熱線2841 9111查核抽籤結果。

署方表示，完成今次周年編配後，食環署將於8月1日起推出全新每月編配安排，全面取代現行的周年編配。新安排下，除屯門曾咀靈灰安置所外，食環署將加入三個靈灰安置所作每月龕位編配，分別為沙田石門靈灰安置所、粉嶺和合石第六期靈灰安置所及柴灣哥連臣角新廈靈灰安置所，每月合共提供不少於1600個可續期骨灰龕位。

title: 未補價資助出售房屋出租計劃擴至白表申請者　提供三千個名額
news_content:
房委會資助房屋小組委員會通過將「未補價資助出售房屋出租計劃」，擴展至合資格白表申請者，以先導形式提供3000個名額。另外，亦通過推行「長者業主樓換樓計劃」，容許所有登記的家庭成員均年滿60歲，並擁有單位滿10年或以上的業主，可於第二市場不需補地價出售現居單位後，購入面積較小又或較偏遠的單位，兩項計劃將於9月接受申請。

「未補價資助出售房屋出租計劃」以先導計劃形式推出，合資格的白表申請者需符合最新一期居屋白表申請資格；業主須持有單位滿10年或以上，若單位租予白表申請者，業主須每季繳交出租准許費，費用會按單位面積及所處地區計算，以一個面積約35平方米的單位為例，以新界、九龍及港島區劃分，每季出租准許費分別為約6900元、約9300元及約1萬元。若租客為公屋申請者，就毋須繳交出租准許費。

參與計劃的單位須整個出租，業主和租客均要持有當局發出的證書，雙方可於「業主及租戶資訊共享平台」或通過地產代理配對，租約為期兩年，「一年死約，一年生約」，兩年租約完結後，租客倘仍符合白表資格，雙方可協商續約及重新議定租金。房委會將監察計劃推行情況，適時檢討成效。

至於「長者業主樓換樓計劃」，當局表示，目的是為長者提供多一個選擇，因他們或希望居住在更接近年輕家庭成員的地區，或在退休後希望居於較偏遠地區以享有更寬敞空間，有關計劃不設任何績效指標。



編輯：黃佩珊

title: 世界盃｜K組哥倫比亞3:1擊敗烏茲別克

哥倫比亞由丹尼爾蒙路斯於40分鐘，門前接應傳送球不著地射入，半場哥倫比亞領先1:0。

首次出席世界盃決賽周的烏茲別克，由菲素利夫於60分鐘，門前頂入追成1:1平手，但追和的局面只維持5分鐘，哥倫比亞由路爾斯戴亞斯，快攻射入，協助球隊再次領先。到補時的最後階段，哥倫比亞由甘柏斯頂入成3:1，為球隊奠定勝局。

K組完成首輪賽事，哥倫比亞以3分排榜首，領先同分的剛果民主共和國同葡萄牙，烏茲別克暫時排榜尾。

title: HK to help nation propel automotive sector
news_content:
Chief Executive John Lee on Thursday said the SAR will grasp opportunities brought by a tech revolution to contribute to the nation's development in building a modern industrial system, and propel its carmaking industry.

Officiating at the 2026 International Automotive Supply Chain Expo, Lee noted China is the world's largest car exporter, with the new energy vehicles industry achieving leapfrog development. 

He said the SAR's first five-year plan – which would roll out as soon as the third quarter – will match accordingly with the nation's 15th Five-Year Plan, which stated that efforts should be made to develop and expand emerging industries to accelerate the development of such sectors. 

"Hong Kong is actively developing new quality productive forces, promoting new industrialisation and accelerating economic transformation," Lee said. 

"With five universities ranked among the world's top 100, Hong Kong brings together research experts from home and abroad, as well as innovation resources and robust capabilities in high-end manufacturing from the Greater Bay Area.

"This will provide strong support for the automotive industry and innovative enterprises to hit the ground running and lead the way in accelerating growth," he added. 

More than 120 strategic firms have set up shop in the SAR since the Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises was established in 2022, Lee said, adding that they include those in the fields of new energy, autonomous driving and AI.

Lee said this would help advance the rapidly growing automotive sector and thereby create synergies. 

He added that the SAR government looks forward to working with the industry to attract global automotive companies in choosing Hong Kong as their base of operations, and to jointly build a major global hub for the industry's innovation.


Edited by Aaron Tam

title: 李家超：全力編制香港五年規劃　為科技強國建設貢獻力量
news_content:
行政長官李家超表示，國家「十五五」規劃指出要發展壯大新興產業，加快新一代智慧網聯新能源汽車等戰略性新興產業發展，因地制宜建設各具特色、優勢互補的戰略性新興產業集群，着力打造一批成長潛力大、技術含量高、滲透領域廣的新興支柱產業。

李家超出席2026國際汽車及供應鏈博覽會開幕禮致辭時表示，政府正全力編制香港第一個五年規劃，會把握科技革命和產業變革帶來的機遇，對接國家建設現代化產業體系的發展，為科技強國建設貢獻力量，在「一國兩制」下，香港擁有背靠祖國、聯通世界的獨特優勢，營商環境高度國際化和市場化，法治傳統源遠流長，擁有國際水平的監管體系。

李家超說，香港積極發展新質生產力，推進新型工業化，加速經濟轉型，本港擁有五所全球百強大學，匯聚海內外的科研專家和國際化研發團隊。另外，引進辦至今已成功吸引超過120家重點企業落戶本港，包括新能源、智能駕駛、人工智能相關企業，與發展日行千里的汽車企業並駕齊驅，發揮聯乘效應，而香港將為企業開拓新能源汽車產業的黃金賽道。

title: 發改委：指導督促做好煤炭等生產供應　確保電力安全穩定供應
news_content:
受山西煤礦事故影響，近期內地部分煤礦需停產檢查。國家發改委政策研究室副主任、新聞發言人李超表示，煤炭安全穩定供應是能源保供工作重要一環，截止本周二，全國統調電廠存煤達到2.1億噸，平均可用34日，認為安全穩定供應具備堅實基礎。

她說，發改委將指導督促有關方面做好煤炭等生產供應，全面抓好安全生產，確保迎峰度夏期間能源電力安全穩定供應。

有報告指過去20年，中國企業全球市場份額增長主要由政府補貼驅動。李超說，把中國產業競爭力簡單歸因於補貼，不僅過於片面，而且完全錯誤，指中國產業競爭力是多方面因素共同作用的結果，包括來自超大規模市場高強度淬煉、完整產業體系高效協同、教育科技人才長期積累以及營商環境持續優化。

她重申，中方反對將經貿問題政治化、工具化，願意與各方一道深化務實合作，共同構築安全穩定、暢通、高效、開放包容、互利共贏的全球產業鏈和供應鏈體系。

有報道稱內地擬大規模投資建設算力網。李超指出，隨著人工智能快速發展，全國一體化算力網建設正加速推進。截止3月底，中國已經建成智能算力規模188.2萬P，是去年同期2.5倍，預計仍將保持高速增長。她說，建設過程中，市場力量將發揮決定性作用，發改委將會同有關部門加強統籌協調和政策引導。



編輯：宋家樑

title: HK, mainland markets slip amid Nikkei and Kospi gains
news_content:
Asian stocks were steady and oil prices dipped on Thursday as investors assessed progress toward ending the war in the Middle East after the presidents of the US and Iran signed an interim peace deal, though uncertainties still hovered.

In Hong Kong, the benchmark Hang Seng Index opened down 166 points, or 0.69 percent, at 24,145. 

The tech index was down 41 points, or 0.88 percent, at 4,628 while the China enterprises index was down 71 points, or 0.88 percent, at 8,072.

On the mainland, the benchmark Shanghai Composite Index opened down 0.34 percent at 4,094.

The Shenzhen Component Index was 0.34 percent lower at 15,826 while the ChiNext Index was down 0.32 percent at 4,153.

In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 Stock Average opened 261 points, or 0.37 percent, up at 70,163 before surging 1,150 points, or 1.65 percent, up to 71,052 at one stage before midday.

In Seoul, the Kospi opened 20 points, or 0.23 percent, higher at 8,884  before edging further up by 53 points, or 0.6 percent, to 8,917 as chipmakers jumped on AI optimism.

The mixed openings came as the United States and Iran released the text of the interim peace deal, which had already circulated widely before its contents were published. It extends a ceasefire announced in April by another 60 days to allow the two sides to negotiate a final truce.

US President Donald Trump, however, threatened to resume attacks and kill Iranian officials if they failed to honour their commitments.

"Major geopolitical risk persists and will also remain a major driver of market action," said Kyle Rodda, a senior financial market analyst at Capital.com. (Reuters & Xinhua)



Edited by Azam Khan

國家發改委政策研究室副主任、新聞發言人李超表示，今年深入優化兩新政策在支持範圍、補貼標準和實施機制，已分兩批下達設備更新資金1851億元人民幣，共支持1.1萬多個項目，總投資超過8400億元。1至5月已下達今年前兩批消費品以舊換新資金1250億元，已累計帶動相關商品銷售額超過8200億元，匯集超過1.1億人次。

她說，將有序安排資金下達，6月底前將下達今年2000億元設備更新全部項目清單，和第三批625億元消費品以舊換新資金，亦會加強項目和資金監管，組織開展兩新政策實施效果評估。

title: 張澤松稱制定中小學數字教育發展藍圖　參考多方意見冀具前瞻性
news_content:
教育局公布課程發展議會編訂的《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》，為未來全港中小學推動教育數字化轉型，提供清晰指導方向與推行策略。課程發展議會委員張澤松表示，制定藍圖過程參考了國家戰略規劃、本地學校實踐情況，以及大、中、小、幼的教育界學者、校長及管理人員等持份者意見，期望藍圖具備前瞻性及能夠「落地」。

張澤松在本台節目《千禧年代》指出，本地中小學在推行電子學習或人工智能AI教育上，缺乏統一標準，學校以校本自主發展，資源較多的學校走得較快，但亦有學校未起步，希望透過藍圖令整體香港學界朝清晰方向發展，讓學生掌握有判斷真偽的能力，推動學生運用科技之餘，要有道德觀及國家安全意識。對於藍圖提出，教育局會與考評局探討推行數字化評估的可行性，張澤松說，坊間及大學部分公開試已數字化，教學及評審無紙化可能會是公開試全球化發展方向之一，可以循序漸進推行。

教育評議會執行委員兼香港道教聯合會圓玄學院第三中學校長賴俊榮在同一節目表示，目前學界使用AI的情況百花齊放，局方推出藍圖是合時宜，讓學校發展有明確目標及指引，而由初小到高中都有教學框架，讓學生可以掌握到一定程度的AI技能。他建議建立平台，方便學校間分享良好運用AI的案例。

藍圖提出要求教師每3年完成不少於30小時的數字教育培訓，賴俊榮預計會增加教師工作量，但相信是大勢所趨，會有助整體學習。他說，部分老師仍停留在使用AI生成圖片或影片，而數字教育是期望讓學生自學，協助找出弱項；老師需培養學生有批判思維，不要盡信AI提供的資料。



編輯：黃佩珊
